details.description: Plackers Micro Mint dental flossers have a thin, strong Super Tuff floss that slides between tight teeth without stretching, fraying or breaking, cleaning away plaque more effectively. A fold-away tartar pick on the handle helps remove food debris. Mint flavoured.
details.usageInstructions: Guide the floss gently between teeth, curve it against each tooth and slide up and down below the gumline. Use the tartar pick to remove food debris. Discard after use.

details.description: Plackers Twin-Line Whitening flossers carry two lines of Super Tuff floss engineered not to stretch, shred or break, removing twice the debris in one pass. The protected fold-away tartar pick helps remove plaque and food debris. Refreshing mint flavour.
details.usageInstructions: Guide the floss gently between teeth, curve it against each tooth and slide up and down below the gumline. Use the tartar pick to remove food debris. Discard after use.

details.description: Plackers Kids flossers are sized for children's mouths, with a dual-grip handle that suits different ages and Super Tuff floss that won't shred. Fruit flavoured to make daily flossing easier for kids. One bag of 75 flossers.
details.usageInstructions: Guide the floss gently between teeth, curve it against each tooth and slide up and down below the gumline. Use the tartar pick to remove food debris. Discard after use.

title: Micro Mint Flossers with Travel Case
